desc:
🎣 CAST. CATCH. COLLECT. 🎣

Throw your line as far as you can and see what bites! The further you cast, the luckier you get, and the stranger the sea becomes.

🌊 20 ZONES to reach, from sunny Shallows to the Throne of the Gods
🐟 182 FISH to discover, from tiny minnows to sea gods bigger than the map
📏 12 SIZES, all the way up to INFINITE (1 in 125,000!)
✨ MUTATIONS: Gold, Diamond, Rainbow and Void
⛈️ SERVER EVENTS: Thunderstorms, Auroras, Blood Moons and more that mutate the fish in your pond
💰 PLACE your catches in your pond and earn cash every second, even the giants
💪 TRAIN your Cast Power, buy better baits and rods, and throw further every time
📖 FILL the Index and show off your rarest catch

Every cast is a mystery. Will it be a 1 in 10... or a 1 in a QUADRILLION?

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite for more updates!
